visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The visual layout is a three-way split screen where a static anime illustration of a young man with spiked pink hair, a red hoodie, and a dark blue high-collared jacket occupies the top and bottom sections. The character's face shows an intense, determined expression with narrowed eyes and clenched teeth, while his fists are raised in a combat-ready pose against a dark background. (2) The central panel displays a mobile MOBA game interface showing a battlefield with green grass, stone paths, and circular magic runes on the ground. A digital avatar resembling the pink-haired character moves rapidly, unleashing glowing blue and yellow energy bursts and shockwaves during combat. (3) The gameplay footage features frequent scene shifts through jungle and lane environments, with numerous UI elements like health bars, gold numbers, and ability icons floating over the action. Colorful skill effects, including lightning bolts and circular energy fields, dominate the central frame as the character engages multiple opponents.

A male voice emits loud, aggressive combat shouts in Japanese with high vocal tension and straining, synchronized with sharp, percussive impact SFX that resemble magical or physical strikes. (2) Each strike is accompanied by a unique digital sound event, ranging from low-frequency thuds to high-frequency crystalline twinkles. The BGM maintains a consistent 140 BPM drive while the vocal track fluctuates with rapid, high-arousal grunts and short phrases, separated by the constant beat of electronic drums. (3) The audio concludes with a sequence of dense, layered impact sounds and a lingering synthesized drone. The final sound event is a crisp, mechanical UI chime that punctuates the end of the combat montage, while the music remains energetic until the cut.
